title: When ego keeps making the self too large after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The self keeps pushing itself to the center of the room. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru names haumai clearly and then redirects the heart toward humility, service, and truth. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: The cure begins when ego is seen as illness rather than identity. Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it.
actionPrompt: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
